comment: Pinned narration model. This GGUF is NOT bundled in the installer: at 2,740,937,888 bytes it
would push the setup executable past the 2 GiB per-file limit on GitHub Releases. It is fetched
once on first run over a resumable, size-and-SHA-256-verified path.
The repository also publishes mmproj-*.gguf multimodal projectors. Passing -hf to llama-server
auto-pulls one of those (~0.9 GB) for Qwen3.5, and this application has no use for vision input.
The model is therefore always loaded from the local file with -m, never with -hf.
sha256 is the git-lfs object id for the blob, which is the SHA-256 of the file contents, read
revision is pinned to a commit so a later push to main cannot silently change the bytes.
